subjects.description: A generic dark car of unspecified make; its form is defined mainly by the glow of its headlights against the surrounding blackness.

description.text: Near-total darkness fills the frame, with only a faint suggestion of depth and ground. A

sits deep in the blackness, its outline barely distinguishable from the surrounding shadow. After a beat of stillness, its headlights snap on and throw a dim cone forward, catching a little texture in the air and a narrow strip of ground. The light is weak and bluish-white, leaving most of the scene swallowed by darkness. No other object or figure is visible. The composition remains severe and withheld, all attention on the newly lit front of the vehicle as the darkness presses in around it.
A low, newly generated engine rumble sits under the darkness.
's headlights snap on and throw a dim cone across the ground.

noses forward, breaking its still silhouette. Its headlights widen into two beams that cut through the dark and reveal more of the hood and the ground immediately ahead. The surrounding blackness begins to recede at the edges of the light, though the wider space remains obscure. Dust or mist in the beam makes the light visible as a faint volume. The car advances slowly and heavily, as if testing the traction, and its shape grows more legible without ever becoming fully detailed. The scene stays sparse: car, beams, darkness, and a small patch of ground emerging beneath the front tires.
The engine rumble deepens as the car begins to move.

rolls fully out of the darkness and into open ground, its tires crossing from black shadow into a slightly lighter, textured surface. The headlights now illuminate a broad stretch ahead, and the rear of the vehicle gradually clears the last wall of dark. The motion is steady and low, with the whole body becoming visible as it enters the open. Around it, the ground remains plain and uncluttered, offering no landmarks beyond the contrast between shadow and the headlight wash. The car continues forward until it fills more of the lit space, the darkness left behind in a soft, receding edge.
The engine rumble rises and tires roll softly over the ground.

json.soundscape: A newly generated low engine rumble grows from near silence into a steady mechanical presence, deepening as the vehicle moves and softening under the tires' roll over open ground.
